title: E-Manager-EF
description:
√一个简单、有用的防炸插件，可以帮助服务器防止几乎任何形式的爆炸物爆炸，并且记录爆炸的地点、物品和引爆人（放置人）
√ A simple and effective anti-explosion plugin that helps servers prevent nearly all forms of explosive detonations, while recording the location, items, and detonator (placer) of explosions
body:
一个**简单、有用**的防炸插件，可以帮助服务器防止**几乎任何形式的**爆炸物爆炸，并且记录爆炸的**地点、物品和引爆人（放置人）**

如果你需要这款插件 ，欢迎自取（在Github Releases或Modrinth下载页） 我们共编译了一版（**使用1.21 API**）

本项目支持Paper/Spigot以及其变种，但不支持Mohist以及Sponce

项目包含文件内容说明：
main.class —— **主类(注册命令)**
EManagerCommand.class —— **命令处理类**（处理爆炸Event/写入日志/对命令emef进行处理）

A **simple and effective** anti-explosion plugin that helps servers prevent **almost any form** of explosive detonation, while recording the **location, items, and detonator (placer)** of the explosion

If you need this plugin, feel free to download it (on the Github Releases or Modrinth download page). We have compiled one version (using the 1.21 API)

This project supports Paper/Spigot and its variants, but does not support Mohist or Sponge

Project File Content Description:
main.class —— **Main Class (Command Registration)**
EManagerCommand.class —— **Command Processing Class** (Handles explosions, writes logs, and processes commands)
